statusDefinitions.fixed_local: A code fix and relevant local falsifiable check exist; not yet deployed or browser-regressed in CI
statusDefinitions.open: Known residual concern, no validated complete fix
statusDefinitions.unverified: A plausible risk awaiting a capable verification environment
statusDefinitions.environment_blocked: The required test was attempted but tooling/environment prevented a verdict
